title: Monet v0.0.2 - Little Desktop Friend
author: jin_sprited
selftext:
Hi folks liked the Monet Animation States Video ([post](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1u2fl9z/monet_various_animation_states_for_my_digital/)). So I made a small open source desktop app that you can clone and run it on your local. It would be awesome if anyone can try it out and let me know. Open to feedbacks on improvements. Uses Electron in the backend.

For the character reference, I used various stuff from Flux 1 Pro, Flux Fill, Open AI Image 2.

For animations, I used Seedance 1.5 Pro (yeah Seedance 2 would have been better).

  
Please give me feedback if you think this project is worth pursuing!!!

Code is MIT License  
Art is CC BY-NC 4.0  
GitHub Link in the comments.

comments.author: ponderdiggums
comments.body: Desktop pets/friends always remind me of Bonzi Buddy, which isn't necessarily the best association. It's not your fault, it's just the era I grew up in. :P

replies.author: jin_sprited
replies.body:
Haha, I just checked it out. Surprised that I've never seen it but I had my own share of tiny desktop widgets inside windows 95. I especially loved the ones that plays midi files bundled with it. I'm thinking of adding such feature on monet so that it doubles as music player.

It was fun times.
